concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-alipayhk-api-only]] — 2026-09-15 Web Advanced API-only Alipay HK add-on for HK/HKD method discovery, redirect and TEST/live setup; high-level form/item wording requires qualification against specific no-extra-field sections, and TEST curl is incomplete.
warnings: High-level steps mention shopper details and conditional item information, while specific form and /payments sections require no additional Alipay HK collection or fields; do not infer a required shopper or item field (raw lines 33–40, 85–87).
TEST curl lacks continuation after -X POST before -d (raw lines 55–69); /v72 is example version, not a stated minimum.
TEST credentials and a listed alipay_hk response do not prove current account enablement or payment outcome.
